stance: Growth: Q3 advance GDP printed 3.4% SAAR, up from 2.2% in Q2. Spending is strong (September retail sales +0.77% m/m; core capex orders +0.46%). September trade deficit -105.0bn (-105.7bn in August). October ISM services is verified at 54.5 (54.9 Sep) with new orders 55.9 (59.8), employment 51.4, prices 73.0: expansion with softer orders. October ISM manufacturing is unconfirmed (one publisher): PMI 55.5. Watch ISM manufacturing confirmation, control group, core capex, later GDP estimates.
